payload.title: Within-well multi-cut coefficient dynamics
payload.statement: Four-control spline targets fitted on several observed pseudo-tails inside a well's known prefix form a coefficient trajectory that predicts the well's final hidden-tail nonlinear coefficients and adds stable value to E011.
payload.evidence_for: T025 confirms a real pseudo-specific signal. The best aggregate candidate reaches 12.424928 RMSE, gaining 0.125829 with 5/5 maps; all corrupted pseudo controls lose. The last-known spline oracle is 4.113743.
payload.evidence_against: The best aggregate placement wins only 16/25 cells. The only preliminary candidate gains 0.098800 but regresses spatial group 0 by 0.132383 and typewell group 4 by 0.245275, and it misses the 0.15 authorization floor.
payload.next_test: Closed by D029. Do not retune the four-cut vector. Test a distinct many-task, long-horizon, outer-well-isolated coefficient meta-learning mechanism under T026.
